rationale: Sv2 #736-D5: {#if cond}, {:else if cond} and {#key exp} heads carry opaque svelte_raw_text under if_start/else_if_start/key_start — no `expression` node ever visits them. Every earlier fixture masked the hole because each condition member was ALSO read elsewhere; here shown/fallback/k appear ONLY in their heads. Pure reads, no bindings (unlike each/await).
